latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YARN resource analysis skill.

- Supports in-depth analysis of YARN cluster resource consumption using SSH and EMR API.
- Provides overall resource trend, queue usage, idle/overprovisioned risk, fragmentation analysis, and health/capacity recommendations.
- Fully decoupled and configuration-driven; data/config/logs are isolated within skill directory.
- Parallel data collection, timeout control, and fast-failure mechanisms for efficiency.
- Outputs markdown-formatted analysis report, with clear logs and error troubleshooting guidance.
